owner: core/prompt-vault (consumer); producers: softwareco/infra/workstation (capture, primary recovery), softwareco/infra/ds1621-admin (offsite recovery)
decision: Operator, 2026-10-03: exact captured Dolt state, verified local/primary recovery and independent offsite recovery, zero accepted state drift at mutation admission. No loss window or time-based validity.
validity: A receipt verifies only while the live vault's branch, HEAD, staged root, working root and every table/schema digest equal the captured manifest. Any change invalidates it; elapsed time never does.

owner_gates_not_verified.db-stage: Gate B: restore smoke test and migration rehearsal on a restored copy
owner_gates_not_verified.db-prod: Gates B and C: rehearsal plus change record and change window

mutation_binding: The admitted transaction re-checks branch, HEAD, staged root and working root against the verified identity before any write and admits nothing on a mismatch.
